summary.note_posts_vs_claude_md: CLAUDE.md states 21 posts as of 2026-08-07; sitemap.xml and content/posts/*.mdx both show 26 as of this audit (2026-08-12).
environment_limitations: No browser automation available; real Core Web Vitals / Lighthouse scores were not measured.
JSON-LD script tags were verified via source code read, not via live-rendered WebFetch output (WebFetch's HTML-to-markdown conversion strips <script> tags).
top_findings: All 26 posts share one byline (Alex Morgan) that contradicts the /about page's claim that a different named person (Badreddine) personally wrote every article
dateModified is hardcoded equal to datePublished in JSON-LD for every post - freshness signal cannot ever be accurate
All 26 posts share the same publish date (2026-08-07) - reads as a single batch-publish
No custom domain live - site only resolves at automatrix-blog.vercel.app
Affiliate CTA (<AffiliateLink>) present in only 5 of 26 posts (19%) despite affiliate revenue being the stated business model
quick_wins: Fix dateModified to track a real last-updated value instead of reusing date
Add <AffiliateLink> CTAs to the 21 posts currently missing one
Add X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options, basic CSP response headers
Reconcile the author story between bylines and the About page

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt allows all, correctly links sitemap.xml
sitemap.xml valid, includes all 26 posts + home/blog/about
No sitewide noindex; robots meta index:true follow:true
Genuine 404 status for nonexistent post URLs (not soft-404)
HSTS present on all responses
Canonical tags set per-post in source
Reasonable page weight (~106-117KB HTML)
Self-hosted Google Fonts via next/font (no render-blocking third-party font request)

findings.title: No custom domain live
findings.description: Site only resolves at automatrix-blog.vercel.app; a .vercel.app subdomain carries weaker trust/brand signal and any future migration needs redirects + GSC re-verification.
findings.recommendation: Set up and DNS-point the intended custom domain, then update SITE_URL constants across layout.tsx, sitemap.ts, robots.ts, blog/[slug]/page.tsx.

findings.title: Missing security response headers
findings.description: No X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy, or Referrer-Policy found on curl -sI checks of / and /blog/claude-ai-review.
findings.recommendation: Add headers via next.config.js headers() function.

findings.title: Sitemap omits indexable pages
findings.description: /privacy-policy and /terms-of-use both return HTTP 200 but are absent from sitemap.xml.
findings.recommendation: Add both URLs to the static entries array in sitemap.ts.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: No AI-crawler discovery file found; not yet a formal standard.
findings.recommendation: Optional low-cost addition given the site's AI/GEO topical focus.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Healthy word counts across all 26 posts (1,062-2,260 words, measured via wc -w on every file)
Consistent answer-first Key Takeaways box on every post
FAQ Q&A pattern present in 26/26 posts, correctly parsed into FAQPage schema
Genuine contextual internal linking with descriptive anchor text
Practical, opinionated tone rather than generic AI filler

findings.title: Author identity contradicts About page
findings.description: All 26 posts bylined 'Alex Morgan' (generic title, picsum placeholder avatar, no bio page); /about names a different real person ('Badreddine') claiming to have personally written every article.
findings.recommendation: Pick one consistent author identity; if 'Alex Morgan' is a house pen name, disclose it and give it a real bio page.

findings.title: dateModified cannot reflect real updates
findings.description: dateModified is hardcoded to equal post.date in every post's JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Add an optional 'updated' frontmatter field defaulting to date, wire into JSON-LD.

findings.title: Affiliate CTAs underused
findings.description: Only 5 of 26 posts (19%) contain an AffiliateLink component despite affiliate revenue being the stated monetization model.
findings.recommendation: Add contextual AffiliateLink CTAs to the remaining 21 posts, prioritizing tool-comparison/review posts.

findings.title: Claims lack outbound citations
findings.description: Spot-checked posts state specific figures (e.g. pricing ranges) without a linked primary source.
findings.recommendation: Add outbound links to vendor pricing pages/official docs for factual claims.

findings.title: One excerpt slightly over meta-description budget
findings.description: automate-repetitive-tasks-with-ai.mdx excerpt is 156 characters vs. the documented 155-char limit.
findings.recommendation: Trim by one character.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title template with unique per-post titles, confirmed live
Meta descriptions sourced from excerpt, within budget for 25/26 posts
Full Open Graph + Twitter Card metadata per post
Canonical tag per post
Programmatically enforced single-H1/sequential-H2/H3 hierarchy across all posts
Contextual internal linking plus Related Articles section
Visual breadcrumb UI on every post
GSC verification meta tag present, confirming prior ownership setup

findings.title: Breadcrumb UI has no matching structured data
findings.description: Visual breadcrumbs render on every post but no BreadcrumbList JSON-LD exists.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList schema alongside existing BlogPosting/FAQPage schema.

findings.title: Unverified Twitter/X handle in metadata
findings.description: layout.tsx sets twitter.site to @automatrixlabs without confirmation the handle exists/is owned.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the handle is real and owned, or remove.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: BlogPosting schema with all required fields on every post
FAQPage schema dynamically generated and confirmed present on all 26 posts
Schema correctly scoped per-post, valid @context/@type

findings.title: dateModified hardcoded equal to datePublished
findings.description: Same underlying issue as content.md - schema-level freshness signal is structurally inaccurate.
findings.recommendation: See content quality action item #2.

findings.title: No sitewide Organization/WebSite schema
findings.description: Only a nested publisher object exists inside each BlogPosting; no standalone entity schema.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD with sameAs links on the homepage or root layout.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList schema
findings.description: Duplicate of on-page finding - noted here as a schema gap specifically.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.

findings.title: Minimal Person author schema
findings.description: Author schema is just a name string, no url/image/jobTitle/sameAs - symptom of the unresolved author-identity issue.
findings.recommendation: Once author identity is resolved, enrich Person schema with real profile data.

findings.title: No Review/AggregateRating schema on review posts
findings.description: Rating/RatingCard component renders scores visually on review-category posts but this isn't mirrored in JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Add Review schema to category:review posts.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: Self-hosted fonts via next/font
Reasonable HTML payload size observed on all fetched pages
next/image used throughout with priority on above-fold hero images

findings.title: Core Web Vitals not measurable in this environment
findings.description: No browser automation/Lighthouse available; LCP/INP/CLS were not measured and this category's score reflects structural HTML/response signals only, not lab or field data.
findings.recommendation: Run a real Lighthouse/PageSpeed/CrUX pass separately before treating this score as a performance measurement.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Answer-first Key Takeaways box on every post
FAQ schema on all 26 posts
Numbered, clearly-scoped H2/H3 structure aids passage-level extraction
Clear entity definitions in intro paragraphs (spot-checked)

findings.title: No outbound citations reduce AI-citation trust
findings.description: Same issue as content.md - factual claims without linked sources are weaker candidates for AI-answer citation.
findings.recommendation: Add sourced citations for statistics/pricing claims.

findings.title: Stale dateModified undercuts freshness signal
findings.description: Same root cause as the technical/schema findings - AI systems weight content freshness and this signal can't currently move.
findings.recommendation: See earlier dateModified fix.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Cover images are real, working Unsplash URLs confirmed via HTTP 200
Author avatars (picsum.photos) resolve via HTTP 302 redirect - not broken
Descriptive, specific alt text on all inline body images checked
next/image used throughout for responsive/optimized delivery
priority attribute correctly used on above-fold hero images

findings.title: Minor inline-image count inconsistency
findings.description: Two posts have only 1 inline image vs. 2-3 in most others.
findings.recommendation: Not urgent; consider for consistency in future edits.

Set up GA4 for this blog
